aggregation_contract.level_pass_condition: every required gate in the level must equal passed
aggregation_contract.local_review_condition: every required L0-L5 gate must equal passed
aggregation_contract.public_rc_condition: local_review_condition plus L6 must pass from a remote detached clone of the exact candidate commit
aggregation_contract.github_released_condition: public_rc_condition plus the release gate must equal passed
aggregation_contract.skipped_policy: skipped is forbidden and must never aggregate to passed

levels.description: Product, API, package, adapter, feature track and source-RC distribution boundary agree.
The public start command launches one Studio URL and verifies the exact source revision, source-dirty state and real multi-agent runtime.
A provider-backed coordinator turn and at least one native specialist delegation produce durable canonical actions.
A conversation-created tabular task imports user CSV, confirms the contract and creates a real Run, evaluation and artifact.
An unregistered task ends in a typed, digest-bound BlockerEvidence with no simulated Run.

AI turn ownership, one authoritative state, stop/recovery, evidence opening, refresh and task re-entry pass on PC at 1280x800, 1440x900 and 1920x1080. PC-only scope explicitly confirmed by the product owner on 2026-09-10.
A remote detached clone of the exact commit installs from locks, starts the complete source RC, repeats the two journeys and survives restart.
The exact verified commit is merged, tagged v1.0.0-rc.1 and published as a GitHub Prerelease with source checksums; no backend-only wheel is labeled as the complete Studio.
